> [!question] Prompt
>
> Write in the present tense as if it is three months in the future.
>
> Where do I want to be and how do I want to feel in three months?

## Mental Health

- I want to be more resilient.
- I want to have actionable methods to lower my stress levels.
- I want to feel capable.
- I want to feel happy.
- I want to feel satisfied.

## Personal

- I want to have my habits and routines become an integral part of my day and that I regard them as such.
- I want to find things that give me a sense of purpose and meaning.
- I want to learn a method for defining my principles and values and then define them.
- I want to learn a method for defining my life's purpose and vision and then define them.

## Professional

- I want to learn to keep a healthy work-life balance.
- I want to have a job that makes me feel fulfilled.
- I want to put my professional life in proportion.
- I want to find the grit to continue even when I am feeling stuck.
